question: Which deities guard the right and left shoulders?
premises: The right shoulder is named as a site of protection.
Girīndreśa is assigned to the right shoulder.
The destroyer of enemies is assigned to the left shoulder.
inference: Each shoulder is placed under a distinct divine guardian.
uncertainties: The fused token vāmaskandherisūdanaḥ combines location and epithet; parsing follows the given form.
plain_english: May the lord of the king of mountains protect the right shoulder, and may the destroyer of enemies protect the left shoulder.
